en.headline: Hong Kong Computer & Communications Festival opens Friday at HKCEC
en.dek: The four-day technology fair runs 21–24 August under the theme ‘AI Connect: Let’s Link the Future’, with an AI and digital transformation zone and more than 20 free workshops.
body: The Hong Kong Computer & Communications Festival 2026 opens on Friday at Hall 1 of the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre and continues until Monday 24 August.

Organised by the Chamber of Hong Kong Computer Industry, this year’s edition carries the theme ‘AI Connect: Let’s Link the Future’. A dedicated AI and digital transformation zone, co-organised with the Hong Kong Productivity Council and sponsored by Samsung, will showcase practical applications for businesses and the public. More than 20 free AI lectures and workshops are scheduled.

Admission is HK$35. Children under one metre, senior citizens aged 65 or above and holders of a valid Registration Card for People with Disabilities are admitted free. Opening hours are 10 a.m. to 9 p.m. from 21 to 23 August and 10 a.m. to 7 p.m. on 24 August. Last admission is one hour before closing.

zh.headline: 香港電腦通訊節周五會展開鑼 主題「AI Connect」
zh.dek: 展覽8月21至24日於灣仔會展1號展覽廳舉行，設AI及數碼轉型專區，並有逾20場免費AI講座及工作坊。
body: 「香港電腦通訊節2026」將於周五（21日）至下周一（24日）在灣仔香港會議展覽中心1號展覽廳舉行。
主辦機構香港電腦商會以「AI Connect: Let’s Link the Future」為主題，首設由香港生產力促進局合辦、三星冠名的「AI及數碼轉型專區」，展示AI在法律、金融、會計及企業營運等實際應用，並安排逾20場免費AI講座及工作坊。
門票售價35元，一米以下小童、65歲或以上長者及持有效殘疾人士登記證人士免費入場。開放時間為21至23日上午10時至晚上9時，24日上午10時至晚上7時，每日閉館前60分鐘停止入場。
